statement: Both all-prime cusp assertions for every actual closure that is a quotient of P×B, with P a finite p-group having cyclic derived subgroup, B abelian of order prime to p, and p=2 or odd p congruent to 3 modulo 4; all intermediates are included.
notes: Full root, DE and PBC proof/source audits PASS. Actual inertia equals the cyclic derived group; the actual elliptic quotient gives p-primary cusp differences and Frattini gives companions. The coprime abelian extension uses the actual connected isogeny pullback, extended Abel map, independently proved compact type and literal rational-path copies. Supersingular reduction places are explicit. Universal A.45 remains Open; no cofinality or arbitrary p-group fixedness claim.
